title: disavowal - tethered to doubt
description:
DIY. Recorded in the living room, bathroom, and garage of an old house venue, Linton House. Loud, noisy, aggressive, abrasive, grimey, wall of sound. I played bass in this, I had just joined the band when we recorded. Now I play drums in the band and most of these tracks have been thrown in the vault. The newer songs go in a different direction and we'll be recording soon? 

 For fans of: Black Metal, Skramz, Noise, and Grindcore music.
